label_note: T_k REAL (laptop RTX 5060, not flight hw); downlink SIM (orbit sim); P_k ASSUMPTION (swept). ES_proc for the default CPU-ONNX build is P-independent. All stage times and MB/day are read LIVE from their source files (see provenance).

stage_time_provenance.preprocess_decode_cpu: UNSOURCED (REAL-derived): report 03 ~1,400 tiles/s warm JPEG decode; not emitted to any results file. Shared stage, cancels in ES_proc.
stage_time_provenance.gate_gpu: REAL live: wp3_gate.json infer_ms_per_tile (pure forward, GPU)
stage_time_provenance.fuse_cpu: definitional: single-tile frame has no cross-slice fusion (B2/SAHI adds it)
stage_time_provenance.semantic_cpu: ASSUMPTION (invented, not measured): LoD encode + schedule decision, CPU

downlink.source: results/passes.csv (SGP4 orbit sim) + sat7.orbit.rate_bps; D_sent/D_raw live from results/wp6_real_table.csv

cpu_onnx_DEFAULT.ES_proc_note: P_cpu cancels (all-CPU) -> = time ratio, power-independent; LOWER BOUND (gate also skips 40.2% of empty tiles, report 04, uncounted here)

gpu_report12_budget.ES_proc_note: depends on P_cpu/P_gpu (classic stage is CPU, detector GPU); energy saving < the 6x TIME saving because the eliminated CPU stage draws less than the retained GPU detector

sahi_variant.label: VARIANT, not the default: the detector is called once per SAHI window instead of once per tile. Stage times REAL (laptop RTX 5060 / CPU, not flight hw); powers ASSUMPTION; fusion time ASSUMPTION (0 ms, never measured) -> every joule here is an ESTIMATE
sahi_variant.applies_to: a pipeline that slices scenes with SAHI (the paper's B2 / B3). The simulated day takes its detections from one detector call per native 768 px tile, which is what the default block above costs.
sahi_variant.detector_calls_source: results/wp26_b0_b4.json: 25 windows per scene / 16 tiles per scene (window 768, overlap 0.20)
sahi_variant.gate_note: once per tile, as the gate is trained and run everywhere it runs (wp3, wp3_score_tiles, wp11): one 128 px view of a whole 768 px tile. No per-window gate exists in the repo.
sahi_variant.fuse_note: ASSUMPTION: the global-coordinate lift + cross-window NMS has never been timed anywhere in the repo, so there is no evidence for or against 0 ms

sensitivity_if_the_gate_ran_once_per_win.note: NOT how the gate runs; shown only because the choice moves ES_proc
